note: The original describes the female alate only; the measurements are recorded item by item as in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to A. gracilis, from which it differs in the inconspicuous fontanelle and the narrower head of the latter.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Female: head chestnut brown, wider than long (from the posterior margin to the base of the postclypeus), covered with dense long hairs. Fontanelle transparent, conspicuous, a nearly elliptical slit on the vertex. Compound eyes black, not very round, small and projecting, closely adjacent to the lateral margins of the head. Ocelli transparent, nearly oval, the upper margin projecting, the distance to the compound eye less than the short diameter of an ocellus. Postclypeus yellowish brown, projecting, bilobed, slightly more than twice as wide as long, covered with dense long hairs. Mandibles yellow to chestnut, not very long. Antennae yellowish brown, 15-segmented, covered with long hairs; segment 3 narrow and shorter than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; gradually longer and wider towards the apex; the last segment narrow, elongate and nearly oval. Pronotum distinctly paler than the head, yellowish brown, slightly narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, the sides smoothly rounded to the nearly straight posterior margin, the whole semicircular. Meso- and metanotal plates deeply and angularly incised. Wings grey, the costal area golden yellowish brown, the wing surface finely punctate, the margin fringed with hairs; in the forewing the media lies near the cubitus and far from the subcosta, with or without branches reaching the wing apex; the cubitus scarcely reaches the wing apex, with 10—12 branches or subbranches reaching the lower margin. Legs pale yellow with brown, slender, covered with long hairs. Abdominal tergites chestnut, covered with dense long hairs; cerci inconspicuous. Measurements: body length with wings 11—12 mm; body length without wings 7.00 mm; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.10 mm; left mandible length 0.50 mm; pronotum length 0.50 mm, width 0.90 mm; hind tibia length 0.85 mm; forewing length 9.50 mm, width 2.60 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.20 mm; head width 0.95 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Tumupasa, Bolivia; the description is based on three female adults collected at the type locality in December (12th month), together with workers of A. indistinctus and a male alate, and on two further female alates from the same locality; other localities are Rosario, Bolivia (dealate female, March (3rd month) 1922; dealate female, October (10th month) 1921). Holotype a female alate, USNM Cat. No. 27662.
